# rustdoc-to-fumadocs

> A TypeScript CLI and ESM library that converts rustdoc JSON into linked MDX pages and sidebar metadata for Fumadocs. Rust produces the input. Node.js runs the converter.

For an inventory, run `rustdoc-to-fumadocs --input crate.json --list-files --json` and read `paths`. For rendered sizes and diagnostics, use `--json` alone and read `files`, `stats`, and `warnings`. Both commands leave the output directory untouched.

To write a complete workspace reference, run `rustdoc-to-fumadocs --workspace . --require-complete --output content/docs/api`. Keep the ownership manifest beside the generated pages for subsequent builds. Match `--base-url` to the URL where the site serves that output.
